thread.title: UPDATE 1-Apple cuts Q1 production plan for new iPhones by 10 pct – Nikkei

author: Editor - Stock Markets News
title: UPDATE 1-Apple cuts Q1 production plan for new iPhones by 10 pct – Nikkei
text:
Posted by Editor - Stock Markets News | Jan 8, 2019 | Stock Market News | 0 |
FILE PHOTO: People look at iPhones at the World Trade Center Apple Store during a Black Friday sales event in Manhattan, New York City, U.S., Nov. 23, 2018. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly/File Photo
(Reuters) – Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) is cutting planned production for its three new iPhone models by about 10 percent for the March quarter, the Nikkei Asian Review reported on Wednesday, a week after the company slashed its quarterly sales forecast.
That rare step exposed weakening demand in China for Apple’s iPhones amid a slowing economy, which has also been buffeted by a bruising trade war with the United States.
Many analysts and consumers have said the new iPhones are overpriced.
Apple asked its suppliers late last month to produce fewer-than-planned models of the XS, XS Max and XR, Nikkei said, citing sources with knowledge of the request. s.nikkei.com/2TEJ02G
The request was made before Apple cut its forecast last week, Nikkei said. The surprise warning triggered a broad sell-off in global stock markets.
Overall planned production volume of both old and new iPhones is expected to be cut to about 40 million to 43 million units for the January-March quarter, from an earlier projection of 47 million to 48 million units, Nikkei reported citing one source familiar with the situation.
Apple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Reporting by Chris Gallagher in TOKYO and Sayantani Ghosh in SINGAPORE; Editing by Christopher Cushing
